blocks.text: Interior design project of a 58 m² apartment in Bratislava, Slovakia

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed a comprehensive interior design project for a 58 m² apartment in Bratislava.

The project covered a complete range of services required to create a modern and functional living space: interior design development, technical documentation, custom furniture design and production, professional decoration, and comprehensive turnkey renovation.

The design covers all key areas of the apartment, including the living room, bedroom, kitchen with individually designed storage solutions and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom. Bespoke furniture solutions were developed for each area, including built-in wardrobes, shelving, and functional storage systems.

With a total area of 58 m², particular attention was paid to making efficient use of every square meter. Carefully considered space planning and custom furniture solutions provide sufficient storage while maintaining a spacious, visually light, and comfortable interior.

Before renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering construction and finishing works, materials, custom-made furniture, and household appliances. This approach made it possible to estimate the main costs in advance and plan each stage of the project implementation.

To clearly present the future interior, photorealistic 3D visualizations were created, showing the proposed materials, furniture, lighting, color combinations, and overall atmosphere of the apartment before implementation.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) provides apartment and private house interior design, custom furniture solutions, and comprehensive turnkey renovation services in Bratislava and other cities across Slovakia.
